decision.expected_output: A reproducible prospective screen specification and structural result ledger identifying which panel members are eligible for later economic study, inconclusive, or structurally unsupported; no live orders and no economic outcome opening.

controls: freeze features, thresholds, target, execution semantics, friction model, missing-data law, tie-break law, and retraining policy before outcomes
preserve symbol-level and panel-level multiple-testing accounting
report gross and cost-adjusted results separately
retain low-sample symbols as inconclusive rather than treating them as failures
apply shared-account margin, concurrency, conflict, capital-flow, and anti-ruin simulation only after structural eligibility
methodology.outer_evaluation: prospective chronological evaluation on the remaining eligible observations after the frozen capture boundary
methodology.promotion_rule: No economic candidate or protected evidence is opened unless the frozen screen passes reproducibility, coverage, cost sufficiency, and prospective validation gates.

scope.universe_rule: Use only the already frozen selected-six panel; do not add symbols adaptively from observed outcomes.

next_research_state.success_condition: The frozen panel is evaluated chronologically with complete coverage, explicit friction and execution semantics, and corrected multiple-testing accounting before any economic candidate is considered.

objective.goal: Convert the completed non-economic session-gap structural evidence into a prospective, independently evaluated screen before considering any economic candidate.
objective.information_gain_rationale: The 12-symbol extension shows heterogeneous event density and directional behavior but no cost-adjusted edge. A pre-registered selected-panel screen with chronology, minimum-coverage, execution-cost, and multiple-testing controls distinguishes repeatable structure from sparse-sample selection without rerunning C031 Stage-B or any observed exact identity.
